BiblicalUsage: Dishan was the fifth son of Seir the Horite, named in the genealogy of Edom, and his name means thresher. The same record names a Dishon who was his brother's son, and the two are easy to confuse.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the genealogies keep the Horites straight even when their names sound alike, because God remembers families the world forgets.
